name: Dah San Electric Wire & Cable Corp.
summary: Dah San Electric Wire & Cable Corp. specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of a comprehensive range of electrical and communication wiring solutions. Its core product portfolio includes various power cables, communication cables, electronic wires, and bare copper conductors. Within its power cable segment, the company provides products suited for low, medium, and high voltage applications. This diverse selection features offerings like crosslinked polyethylene (PE) and polyvinyl chloride (PVC) cables, flexible PVC cords, PVC-insulated and sheathed portable cables, and specialized signal control, flame-resistant, heat-resistant, alarm, and control cables. Furthermore, Dah San offers communication cables, encompassing types such as coaxial and local area network (LAN) cables, alongside a variety of electronic wires. Its bare copper wire selection includes hard-drawn copper, hard-drawn stranded copper, annealed copper, and annealed or tinned stranded copper wires. Beyond its product offerings, the firm provides expert technical and engineering services. These services are specifically tailored for high voltage power cable circuits, covering aspects such as circuit design, wiring and construction engineering, termination and jointing engineering, and ongoing maintenance support. Established in 1964, Dah San Electric Wire & Cable Corp. is headquartered in Yunlin, Taiwan.
